scopeReview: CED Topic 6.14 and Skill 1.C: choose justified antidifferentiation procedures from AB content already developed. Non-exclusive valid methods are acknowledged; selection considers derivative matching, degrees, completed squares, domains, parity and numerical integration. No BC-only method is introduced. Written strategy validity and every distractor are separately reviewed; numeric models corroborate the associated result rather than universally proving a prose method.
varietyReview: Affine-power chain factor, degree-based division, shifted quadratic completion, two valid trig substitutions with constants differing, power-rule exception −1, full nonlinear inner derivative, numerical integration versus false primitives, scaled inverse tangent, invalid quotient integration, odd-symmetry shortcut and a missing-differential factor. Eight primitive/integral result corroborations and three exact strategy/domain reasoning reviews.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
